question: Can the factory proceed beyond its first Gemini brief on a stable free-tier model after gemini-3.5-flash-lite returned HTTP 503 UNAVAILABLE?

official_evidence.supports: Stable model; multimodal input and structured outputs.
Standard free-tier text/image input and text output for Gemini 3.1 Flash-Lite.

required_before_new_acceptance: Update app, private gateway source and generated workflow to the same model endpoint.
Pass material-first and factory-v3 tests, gateway validators, exact linux/amd64 packaged suites with network disabled.
Verify only the authorized gateway workflow changed, app health/model revision, free-tier billing=false, protected production snapshots, and no active work before/after scoped rollout.
Create one new bounded UK60 Vision request only after the model proof; keep its ID immutable.
stop_conditions: Model metadata or billing proof is unavailable or not free-tier.
Provider returns an ambiguous result; never retry that request ID.
Any unrelated workflow, database row, service image, credential or billing state changes.
